name: Transfer Function Reconstruction Loss
definition: A loss function for optimizing the Transfer Function (TF) to match reference images, combining an L1 image loss and a smoothing prior on the TF.
summary: Transfer Function Reconstruction Loss optimizes transfer functions by minimizing pixel-wise differences between rendered and reference images using L1 loss and a smoothing prior, differing from direct tuning by backpropagating image-space errors via differentiable volume rendering.
